heard: A dead star halfway to the moon could erase your credit cards. This cosmic monster is a magnetar, an ultra-dense star only 20 kilometers wide. It generates a magnetic field of 1,000 trillion gauss, the strongest in the universe. On December 27, 2004, a starquake on one magnetar triggered a giant flare. In one-tenth of a second, the flare released more energy than our sun emits in 100,000 years. The blast traveled across the galaxy and briefly ionized and expanded Earth's upper atmosphere. That same magnetic fury is why a dead star halfway to the moon could erase your credit cards.
